title: Imp Jar Fizz Cola 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Cola from Imp Jar Fizz brings you the age-old, comforting flavour of fizzy Cola. It's like sipping on your favourite soda, complete with the satisfying, bubbly sensation and the nostalgic sweetness that hits all the right notes. This delicious flavour is just one of several in Imp Jar’s Fizz series, a collection of vape juices which sparkle with all the fun and flavour of your favourite classic soda drinks. They feature a double-concentrate of extra flavour providing an intensely tasty experience akin to a disposable vape. Shortfill bottles from Imp Jar E-liquids offer a more versatile ratio of 50PG/50PG than traditional High-VG shortfills, which means you can use the e-liquid with a more diverse range of vape kits and coils of different resistances. With Imp Jar shortfills, you’re no longer limited to sub-ohm vaping kits, and can enjoy the superb value of shortfills in a huge variety of MTL vape kits. Each bottle comes with 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 10ml of space for one 10ml nicotine shot, giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 60ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 1 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Shortfills offer even more longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours and are a more economical and convenient option over 10ml bottles of pre-mixed e-liquid. Imp Jar’s original collection of e-liquids replicate a wide array of delicious flavours made popular across numerous disposable vape devices, ranging from fruity delights to frosty menthols, sugary candies, to refreshing beverages.
